subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers continue routing this issue through the existing conflicting cross-repo PR, or allow a narrow replacement fix that covers both custom-prompt mutation and the transcript/model prompt split?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible and narrow, but the repository has no-new-fix-pr and linked-pr-open signals while the referenced closing PR is conflicting, unmerged, and incomplete against the broader evidence.

options.title: Allow a narrow replacement fix
options.body: Permit a maintainer-owned or ClawSweeper replacement PR that preserves the configured prompt for the model while retaining the transcript marker only for storage/export.

options.title: Repair the existing cross-repo PR
options.body: Ask the author to rebase and expand https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/228 so it covers the full prompt boundary and includes real behavior proof.

options.title: Keep waiting on linked PR
options.body: Leave the no-new-fix-pr posture unchanged, accepting that the issue remains open until the conflicting fork PR becomes viable.

recommendation.title: Allow a narrow replacement fix
recommendation.body: Permit a maintainer-owned or ClawSweeper replacement PR that preserves the configured prompt for the model while retaining the transcript marker only for storage/export.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is about routing a core heartbeat/reply-runtime fix, and recent history shows steipete as the most active adjacent contributor in these surfaces.
